04182 Mowresheth Gath {mo:-re'-shet gat}

源自 03423 和 01661; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Moreshethgath 1; 1

摩利設迦特 = "迦特的所有物"
1) 顯然在迦特臨近之地, 或許是先知彌迦的家鄉 (#彌 1:14|)

04182 Mowresheth Gath {mo-reh'-sheth gath}

from 03423 and 01661;; n pr loc

AV - Moreshethgath 1; 1

Moresheth-gath = "possession of Gath"
1) a place apparently in the neighbourhood of Gath and probably the
   home of the prophet Micah
